title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saints D/ST recovers fumble Sunday
items.desc: The Saints D/ST allowed 35 points on 381 total yards with three sacks and a fumble recovery on Sunday against the Raiders.
items.impact: The Saints were unable to force any interceptions on Kirk Cousins. It did not help that the Saints offense turned the ball over four times in the final quarter. They'll face Bijan Robinson and the Falcons next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daniel Carlson misses extra point Sunday
items.desc: Daniel Carlson made 3-of-4 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Carlson did not attempt a field goal. He is 4-of-5 on field goal attempts to start the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Noah Fant hauls in two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Noah Fant caught 4-of-4 targets for 33 yards and two touchdowns in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday.
items.impact: Fant and Juwan Johnson both hauled in two touchdowns on the day. Despite that, Fant remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Juwan Johnson catches two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Juwan Johnson caught 8-of-8 targets for 53 yards in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday.
items.impact: It must have been tight end day in New Orleans as the two teams combined for six touchdowns caught by tight ends. Johnson remains a steady weekly play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Devaughn Vele catches three passes Sunday
items.desc: Devaughn Vele caught 3-of-6 targets for 39 yards in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday.
items.impact: Vele was relatively quiet for most of the afternoon. It was Chris Olave and the tight ends who dominated on the day for New Orleans. He remains an upside flex play heading into next week against the Falcons.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Olave records 107 yards Sunday
items.desc: Chris Olave caught 9-of-13 targets for 107 yards in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday.
items.impact: Olave continues to lead the Saints in receiving on a week in and week out basis. He is a WR1 moving forward for fantasy managers with his involvement to start the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendre Miller sees four carries Sunday
items.desc: Kendre Miller ran for 14 yards on four carries in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for five yards receiving.
items.impact: Miller saw some opportunity with Travis Etienne Jr. exiting early. Alvin Kamara was still the lead back in that span.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alvin Kamara sees nine carries Sunday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara ran for 36 yards on nine carries in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday. He also caught his lone target for five yards receiving.
items.impact: Kamara saw his role expand after Travis Etienne Jr. left the game early. He'll be in the flex conversation next week if Etienne is sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Shough throws four touchdowns, struggles with turnovers late
items.desc: Tyler Shough completed 29-of-42 passes for 255 yards with four touchdowns and one interception in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday.
items.impact: Shough was dealing through the first three quarters, tossing four touchdowns with two of them going to Juwan Johnson and the other two going to Noah Fant. The Saints turned the ball over four times in the fourth quarter with three of them being committed by Shough on an interception and two fumbles. He'll face the Falcons next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Raiders D/ST comes through late Sunday
items.desc: The Raiders D/ST allowed 27 points on 381 total yards with one interception, three fumble recoveries and two sacks on Sunday against the Saints.
items.impact: It was quite the fourth quarter for the Raiders defense as they forced four turnovers to help seal the win and move to 3-0 on the season. They'll draw Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matt Gay connects on five kicks Sunday
items.desc: Matt Gay made 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Gay connected on field goals from 41, 37 and 25 yards out. He is 7-for-7 on field goal attempts through the first three games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Mayer hauls in touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Michael Mayer caught 3-of-3 targets for 32 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints on Sunday.
items.impact: Mayer still made an impact despite the return of Brock Bowers. It was tight end day in New Orleans as the two teams combined for six touchdowns scored by tight ends.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Bowers dominates in return Sunday
items.desc: Brock Bowers caught 10-of-13 targets for 116 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints.
items.impact: Bowers was making his season debut and he did not miss a beat. He was involved early and often. He remains a high-end TE1 moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Nailor catches one pass Sunday
items.desc: Jalen Nailor caught 1-of-3 targets for 16 yards in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints on Sunday.
items.impact: Nailor remains uninvolved in the offense with Las Vegas. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cody White catches touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Cody White caught 1-of-3 targets for four yards and a touchdown in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints on Sunday.
items.impact: White now has three touchdowns in the past two weeks coming off the practice squad. Still be remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre Tucker hauls in four passes Sunday
items.desc: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-4 targets for 43 yards in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints on Sunday.
items.impact: Tucker led Raiders wide receivers in receptions and yards. Still his upside remains limited for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. ran for 54 yards and a touchdown on five carries in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints on Sunday.
items.impact: Washington found the end zone on an impressive run. He remains the clear backup behind Ashton Jeanty in the Raiders backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ashton Jeanty struggles on ground Sunday
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty ran for 56 yards on 19 carries in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints. He also caught 3-of-3 targets for 36 yards receiving.
items.impact: Jeanty was inefficient on the ground for the second straight week. He still remained active in the passing game. He remains an RB1 in a workhorse role moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kirk Cousins throws three touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Kirk Cousins completed 22-of-33 passes for 248 yards with three touchdowns in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints on Sunday.
items.impact: Cousins enjoyed the return of Brock Bowers in a big way Sunday afternoon as the two connected on 10 passes for 116 yards and a touchdown. Cousins also threw touchdowns to Michael Mayer and Cody White. He'll face the Chiefs next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Buccaneers D/ST records interception Sunday
items.desc: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 23 points on 230 total yards with an interception and three sacks on Sunday against the Vikings.
items.impact: The Bucs defense did everything they could to keep the team in the game. They'll face Jordan Love and the Packers next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase McLaughlin makes three field goals Sunday
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin connected on 3-of-3 field goals and his lone extra point on Sunday.
items.impact: McLaughlin connected on field goals from 28 yards, 38 and 54 yards out. He remains a steady option for fantasy managers week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Otton a safety blanket for the Buccaneers Sunday
items.desc: Cade Otton caught 3-of-6 targets for 56 yards in the Buccaneers 23-16 loss against the Vikings on Sunday.
items.impact: Otton was second on the team in targets on the day. He has seen at least five targets in all three weeks to start the season. He'll remain a high floor tight end play next week against the Packers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ted Hurst III hauls in deep touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Ted Hurst III caught 1-of-4 targets for 40 yards receiving and a touchdown in the Buccaneers 23-16 loss against the Vikings on Sunday.
items.impact: Hurst caught a 40-yard deep ball from Baker Mayfield in the first half for a score. It was his lone catch on the day. The status of Mayfield will need to be monitored after he left late in the loss.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. catches three passes Sunday
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. caught 3-of-4 targets for  25 yards in the Buccaneers 23-16 loss against the Vikings on Sunday.
items.impact: Godwin continues to not be able to make a huge impact on the field. With Baker Mayfield also dislocating his thumb late in the loss, Godwin will be tough to trust in lineups based on his slow start to the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emeka Egbuka totals 62 yards Sunday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka caught 5-of-9 targets for 62 yards in the Buccaneers 23-16 loss against the Vikings on Sunday.
items.impact: Egbuka was the leading receiver for Tampa Bay on the day. He has still yet to have one of his huge explosive games. The status of Baker Mayfield will need to be monitored after he left the game late with a dislocated thumb.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Gainwell quiet again Sunday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell ran for -4 yards on three carries in the Buccaneers 23-16 loss against the Vikings on Sunday. He also caught 2-of-5 targets for 14 yards receiving.
items.impact: Gainwell was once again not involved much. It is worth noting Bucky Irving was on the sideline for most of the final quarter. The status of Irving will need to be monitored this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bucky Irving does not play late in game Sunday
items.desc: Bucky Irving ran for 46 yards on 15 carries in the Buccaneers 23-16 loss against the Vikings on Sunday. He also caught 2-of-4 targets for 12 yards receiving.
items.impact: Irving sat on the sideline for most of the fourth quarter and it is unclear why. There will likely be an update on him early this week. He still saw 15 of the 18 carries for Bucs running backs on the day. He faces a vulnerable Packers defense next week if he is good to go.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalon Daniels throws interception in final drive Sunday
items.desc: Jalon Daniels threw an interception in the final drive of the Buccaneers 23-16 loss against the Vikings on Sunday.
items.impact: Daniels came in for an injured Baker Mayfield in the final drive of the game. Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles Mayfield dislocated his right thumb and will undergo an MRI.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Vikings D/ST dominates in win Sunday
items.desc: The Vikings D/ST allowed 16 points on 243 total yards with six sacks and two interceptions on Sunday against the Bucs.
items.impact: The Vikings D/ST also scored a touchdown on a punt return. Minnesota needed its defense to come through as the offense struggled for most of the afternoon. They will be a top play next week against the Dolphins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Reichard makes five kicks Sunday
items.desc: Will Reichard connected on 3-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Reichard made field goals from 54, 56 and 43 yards out. He hit two huge field goals late in the fourth quarter to help Minnesota hold off the Bucs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: T.J. Hockenson quiet Sunday
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson caught 2-of-4 targets for 11 yards receiving in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: Hockenson was uninvolved despite Justin Jefferson (ankle) exiting early. He could be in the streaming conversation next week against the Dolphins if Jefferson is sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jauan Jennings catches one pass Sunday
items.desc: Jauan Jennings caught 1-of-2 targets for one yard in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: Jennings was unable to take advantage of the absence of Justin Jefferson (ankle) leaving early. He remains off the fantasy radar for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Addison leads the way for Vikings Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Addison caught 5-of-9 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: Addison took on a bigger role with Justin Jefferson (ankle) exiting early. He hauled in a 41-yard touchdown pass from Kyler Murray. He'll jump into a WR2/WR3 play next week against the Dolphins if Jefferson is sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Demond Claiborne sees three carries Sunday
items.desc: Demond Claiborne ran for one yard on three carries in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: Claiborne saw some more run with Jordan Mason (thumb) on IR. He remains a pure stash for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. totals 22 touches Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. ran for 58 yards on 17 carries in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday. He also caught 5-of-6 targets for 34 yards receiving.
items.impact: It wasn't the most efficient performance for Jones, but his overall volume made up for it. He'll be an RB2 play next week against the Dolphins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Murray has underwhelming day Sunday
items.desc: Kyler Murray completed 15-of-29 passes for 168 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: Murray was playing in his first game back from the concussion protocol. He lost Justin Jefferson early for the day. He targeted Jordan Addison heavily, including on a 41-yard touchdown. He'll face the Dolphins next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: 49ers D/ST struggles late Sunday
items.desc: The 49ers D/ST allowed 30 points on 365 total yards with two sacks on Sunday against the Cardinals.
items.impact: San Francisco allowed just six points in the first half before allowing 24 points in the second half. They'll face Bo Nix and the Broncos next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eddy Pineiro misses two extra points Sunday
items.desc: Eddy Pineiro made his lone field goal and 3-of-5 extra points on Sunday.
items.impact: Pineiro made his lone field goal from 57 yards out. It was a rare off day for him kicking extra points.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Watkins totals 60 yards Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Watkins caught 2-of-2 targets for 60 yards in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
items.impact: Watkins saw more snaps with Mike Evans (rib) exiting early. He could see more opportunity if Evans misses more time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Kittle scores twice Sunday
items.desc: George Kittle caught 6-of-7 targets for 82 yards and two touchdowns in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
items.impact: Kittle took on a bigger role with Mike Evans (rib) exiting early. He hauled in two touchdowns from Brock Purdy in the win. He remains a strong TE1, especially if Evans misses time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. scores long touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. recorded an 80-yard touchdown on a lateral in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
items.impact: Samuel took a lateral from Mike Evans to the house for an 80-yard touchdown in the opening drive. He could see more involvement next week if Mike Evans (rib) misses time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kaelon Black quiet Sunday
items.desc: Kaelon Black ran for 17 yards on four carries in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
items.impact: Black saw one target which he didn't haul in. Christian McCaffrey took over as the clear lead back on the afternoon. Black remains a stash for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian McCaffrey finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey ran for 75 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday. He also caught 4-of-5 targets for 41 yards receiving.
items.impact: McCaffrey took over as the clear lead back on Sunday. He found the end zone in the fourth quarter as the Cardinals were making a comeback. He remains a strong RB1 moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Purdy tosses four touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Brock Purdy completed 15-of-27 passes for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
items.impact: Purdy also had a rushing score late that was called back on a penalty by George Kittle. His first passing touchdown was a completion to Mike Evans, who lateraled the ball to Deebo Samuel for the long score. He draws a tougher matchup against the Broncos next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Arizona Cardinals D/ST struggles Sunday
items.desc: The Arizona Cardinals D/ST allowed 36 points on 437 total yards on Sunday against the 49ers.
items.impact: It was a field day for Brock Purdy and the 49ers offense with four passing touchdowns and a rushing score. The Cardinals defense remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chad Ryland connects on six kicks Sunday
items.desc: Chad Ryland connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Ryland made field goals from 26, 41 and 49 yards out. His last field goal made the game one score in the final 40 seconds.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey McBride hauls in nine passes Sunday
items.desc: Trey McBride caught 9-of-11 targets for 75 yards in the Cardinals 36-30 loss against the Cardinals on Sunday.
items.impact: McBride continues to be the safety blanket for Jacoby Brissett all over the field every week. He and Brock Bowers remain 1A and 1B among the tight end position.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendrick Bourne catches two passes Sunday
items.desc: Kendrick Bourne caught 2-of-3 targets for 22 yards in the Cardinals 36-30 loss against the 49ers on Sunday.
items.impact: Bourne has not been as involved the past two weeks after a big Week 1 performance. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. totals 40 yards Sunday
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards in the Cardinals 36-30 loss against the 49ers on Sunday.
items.impact: The talk around the NFL the past two weeks has been Harrison not being targeted by Jacoby Brissett. He was a little more involved this week, but still not enough to be trustworthy in fantasy lineups.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Wilson hauls in 11 passes Sunday
items.desc: Michael Wilson caught 11-of-17 targets for 89 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals 36-30 loss against the 49ers on Sunday.
items.impact: Wilson posted his biggest performance of the early season fresh off his contract extension this past offseason. He hauled in a touchdown from Jacoby Brissett in the third quarter. He profiles as a WR3 heading into next week against the Giants.
